item.title: 我无法通过快捷键使用文本提取器
item.author: GISer-Qiu

judgment.rationale: The issue says Text Extractor cannot be used by shortcut but provides no steps, expected/actual behavior, configured shortcut, enabled state, or diagnostic ZIP; source shows the hotkey only triggers the OCR event while the module is enabled.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2362, GitHub install, TextExtractor area, Windows 10.0.26200, zh-Hans-HK locale, non-elevated per-user install.
Steps/expected/actual fields are empty or no response.
origin/main PowerOCR defaults to Win+Shift+T and sets SHOW_POWEROCR_SHARED_EVENT only when enabled.
Command Palette Text Extractor command sets the same shared event, useful as comparison.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for configured shortcut, exact symptom, Command Palette comparison, and fresh /bugreport after failed hotkey.

fix_assessment.rationale: Insufficient evidence to identify a PowerToys code defect.

issue_context.summary: A Simplified Chinese/Hong Kong locale user reports Text Extractor cannot be invoked via keyboard shortcut but did not provide symptom details.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 stable from GitHub, per-user, non-elevated.
No repro steps or bug report ZIP supplied.
inferences: Could be disabled module, shortcut conflict, elevated-window mismatch, OCR process startup failure, keyboard layout issue, or shortcut misunderstanding.
issue_context.analysis: Exact shortcut/config and Command Palette comparison are the minimal evidence that changes triage.
initial_investigation: Read live activity through 2026-09-02T03:40:59Z; no comments beyond labels.
Checked origin/main PowerOCR module and Command Palette Text Extractor command at 5abd20e355998a865075a06676bebfc1d9925be4.

information_gaps.information: Configured shortcut, module enabled/conflict state, exact result, and whether Command Palette Text Extractor works.
information_gaps.why_needed: Separates config/conflict from hotkey registration or OCR process startup failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Press shortcut once, try Command Palette Text Extractor once, then comment /bugreport immediately afterward.

comment.body: We need a few Text Extractor-specific details before this can be triaged as a code bug. Please provide: 1. the shortcut shown in PowerToys Settings and whether a conflict is reported; 2. what happens when you press it; 3. whether launching Text Extractor from Command Palette works. After trying the shortcut once, comment `/bugreport` so hotkey/startup logs are captured.
